description: Engine §4: a recursive prefix forest tags query is a grammar error.
grammar:
%rule text "a"
%conditions $.parse(… outer)
%rule outer "a"
%conditions $.parse(… recursive)
%rule recursive ε
%conditions P ⊆ $.parse(recursive …).tags

expect.message: a condition asks whether its own span parses as recursive from inside the parse of that span as recursive: the grammar defines recursive in terms of itself over the same text
